purpose: Daily CPU/GPU price reconciliation, stock verification and standardized 100-point scorecards for the 2026 Black Friday PC purchase

cpu.interpretation: 同一配点で比較。Cities: Skylines II等のシミュレーション、制作・分析、消費電力、購入目標価格、AM5継続性、販売証拠を評価。

gpu.interpretation: WQHD性能スコア、CUDA/ROCm/oneAPIの実用互換性、VRAM、性能スコア÷TGPの効率proxy、購入目標価格、保証/在庫証拠を評価。

score_policy.performance_per_watt_proxy: 2026-11-11 GPU comparison score divided by published TGP; not a measured wall-power benchmark
score_policy.provisional_unknown_price_rule: 価格が未確認の候補はprice_vs_targetを中立7/15とし、必ず暫定と明記する。
score_policy.note: Daily CPU/GPU comparison scores are distinct from the repository's existing full-build score, component fit score and dynamic purchase-evidence score. Do not compare these scales as if they measure the same thing.
score_policy.evidence_completeness_score_definition: Separate 0-100 confidence score: exact model identity, direct current product page, current price, stock, seller, shipping, delivery, warranty/return terms, and for used cards physical-condition and operating-test evidence. It does not change the hardware-fit score.

performance_and_power.system_wall_power: not measured in this run; do not infer from component TGP/TDP

review_power_observations.source: ComputerBase RX 9070/XT and RTX 5070/5070 Ti review; ComputerBase RTX 5060 Ti 16GB review
review_power_observations.interpretation: The 84W uncapped gaming-power difference shrinks to 5W with a 144-FPS WQHD cap in the ComputerBase test. Transient spikes after idle-to-full-load are unusually high, so PSU quality and transient handling matter. These are review bench results, not guaranteed board power for every partner model.

measured_gpu_power.note: Measured board power from ComputerBase test conditions; not whole-PC wall power. At a 144fps cap, RX 9070 and RX 9070 XT were 91W and 96W respectively.

annual_gpu_cost_estimates.assumptions: 3 hours/day, 365 days/year, ¥31/kWh; based on measured average gaming board power where available.

decision.cpu: 9700X Ark ¥44,800 is the efficiency/value leader and is ¥4,800 above the ¥40,000 target, but Ark has a dispatch-delay notice. 9800X3D ¥71,800 is the simulation choice but ¥11,800 above target. 9850X3D is ¥81,800, ¥10,000 above 9800X3D for modest WQHD gains and lower gaming efficiency; low priority.
decision.gpu: No target reached. Best current budget paths are RX 9070 16GB ¥125,800 in stock for gaming/efficiency, or RTX 5060 Ti 16GB ¥144,980 for CUDA/Windows AI. ASUS RTX 5070 ¥149,800 is faster but only 12GB and 1-year warranty.
